title: 누구하고, 뭐하고? 친구하고 같이, 빵하고 우유
objective: By the end, you can use 하고 to join two nouns and to say who you do something with. You can also choose 와/과 for writing and 이랑/랑 for casual talk, based on the noun's last sound.
summary: Learn the particle 하고 for listing nouns ("and") and for people you do things with ("with"), and see how it compares with 와/과 and 이랑/랑.

task.title: Choose and write particles
task.line: Look at the noun's last sound and the situation (talking or writing), then choose or write the right form.

forms.when: To list two or more things. It is the same after any noun, with or without a final consonant. Used mostly in speech.
forms.exampleMeaning: I bought bread and milk at the convenience store.

forms.when: To say who you do something with. 같이 (together) is often added after it.
forms.exampleMeaning: I watched a movie with a friend on the weekend.

forms.form: N + 과 (final consonant) / 와 (no final consonant)
forms.when: Same meaning as 하고, but used in writing, notices, and formal speech.
forms.exampleMeaning: There is juice and water, and bread and fruit.

forms.form: N + 이랑 (final consonant) / 랑 (no final consonant)
forms.when: Same meaning as 하고, but used in casual talk with friends and family.
forms.exampleMeaning: Yesterday I ate tteokbokki with my younger sibling and my older sister.

watchOut: 빵와 우유 (X) → 빵과 우유 (O): 빵 ends in a consonant, so use 과.
친구이랑 (X) → 친구랑 (O): 친구 has no final consonant, so use 랑.
친구 하고 (X) → 친구하고 (O): 하고 is a particle, so write it right after the noun with no space.
빵을하고 우유를 (X) → 빵하고 우유를 (O): Put 을/를 only on the last noun.
exercises: Choose 와 or 과 (writing): ① 책상____ 의자 ② 바지____ 신발
Choose 이랑 or 랑 (casual talk): ① 엄마____ 시장에 가요. ② 선생님____ 이야기했어요.
Join the two foods with 하고 and finish the sentence: 김밥, 라면 → 어제 ____ 먹었어요.
Find the mistake and write the sentence correctly: 문구점에서 연필을하고 공책을 샀어요.
Choose the better word for each situation: ① Text to a friend: 내일 누나(하고 / 와) 영화 봐. ② Written notice: 이름(과 / 이랑) 전화번호를 쓰세요.
Answer in Korean with 하고, using the word in brackets: 누구하고 점심을 먹었어요? (형)
